ops.old: Whisk 150g flour, 50g cornflour and 300ml cold lager to a batter. Cut 600g potatoes into chips and fry twice. Dip 500g flathead strips in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Serve in paper cones with tartare and lemon.
ops.new: Whisk 150g flour, 50g cornflour and 300ml cold lager to a batter. Cut 600g potatoes into chips and fry twice. Dip 500g cod strips in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Serve in paper cones with tartare and lemon.

ops.old: Flathead strips dredged and dipped in a beer batter (flour, cornflour, cold lager), fried at 180C. Chips double-fried. Paper cones, tartare and lemon.
ops.new: Cod strips dredged and dipped in a beer batter (flour, cornflour, cold lager), fried at 180C. Chips double-fried. Paper cones, tartare and lemon.

ops.old: Cut the chips and keep them in cold water up to 1 day ahead; cut the flathead into strips up to 4 hours ahead, chilled; batter and fry on the night
ops.new: Cut the chips and keep them in cold water up to 1 day ahead; cut the cod into strips up to 4 hours ahead, chilled; batter and fry on the night

ops.old: Flathead in a cold alcohol-free lager batter, thick potatoes done twice. Tartar sauce and lemon.
ops.new: Cod in a cold alcohol-free lager batter, thick potatoes done twice. Tartar sauce and lemon.

ops.old: Dip the flathead strips in batter and fry in the oil at 180C until golden.
ops.new: Dip the cod strips in batter and fry in the oil at 180C until golden.
